name: ASPCA Community Veterinary Clinic
aka: ASPCA Community Veterinary Clinic (Rachael Ray Foundation)
region_note: ASPCA COMMUNITY VETERINARY CLINICS - by borough (appointment only, income-qualified)
notes:
South Bronx: s/n + wellness by appointment for eligible dog/cat owners. Start via the Same-Day Waitlist at clinic.aspca.org/locations/new-york-city. (Low-cost urgent care at the ASPCA Animal Hospital requires household income <= $50k.)

East New York: s/n + wellness by appointment for eligible owners. Same-Day Waitlist at clinic.aspca.org/locations/new-york-city.

Long Island City: s/n + wellness + routine care by appointment for eligible Queens residents. clinic.aspca.org/locations/new-york-city.
